hook: Camper: an indie mobile Bandcamp client built
hookText: Camper: an indie mobile Bandcamp client built

beats.say: Iheanyi Ekechukwu released Camper for iOS and Android, a Bandcamp app for streaming and offline listening to your collection, discovery via Bandcamp Radio and Daily, wishlists and purchases.
Frustrated with Bandcamp's official app after more than a decade of buying music there, he built Camper on top of Bandcamp's Subsonic API.
Besides online and offline playback of your collection, search and wishlisting, it adds Last.fm scrobbling and reminders for Bandcamp Fridays and Listening Parties.
